name: @zhenre/router
description: @zhenre router — history/hash routing with params, async guards, redirects, reactive route signal and an animation-ready outlet. Zero dependencies.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --external:@zhenre/core --outfile=dist/router.js && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --external:@zhenre/core --minify --outfile=dist/router.min.js && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
